title: GroundCheck Technical Retrieval, Groundedness & Epistemic Calibration Benchmark v1.0
description: Repeatable 10-case evaluation suite testing exact lexical retrieval, semantic paraphrase matching, multi-hop synthesis, conflict detection across discrepant specs, and honest abstention on unsupported topics.

cases.question: What are the calibrated valve ratios gamma_1 and gamma_2 in the non-minimum-phase QuadTank-FDI configuration, and what is the EKF sampling period?
cases.rationale: Tests exact extraction of multivariable control parameters and EKF sampling rate from Section 1 and Section 2 of the QuadTank-FDI spec.

cases.question: How is the CUSUM fault detection threshold J_th calibrated in QuadTank-FDI, and what is the mean isolation latency for actuator gain degradation?
cases.rationale: Tests retrieval of statistical fault detection thresholds (J_th = 14.5, FAR < 0.2%) and isolation latency (420 ms).

cases.question: How does BridgeTest construct the HMAC-SHA256 webhook signature and what replay tolerance window is enforced?
cases.rationale: Tests lexical + semantic retrieval of cryptographic webhook verification rules and replay protection window.

cases.question: What exponential backoff parameters and Dead-Letter Queue (DLQ) retention policies are used when webhook delivery fails?
cases.rationale: Verifies retrieval of retry cap (900 seconds), max attempts (8), and DLQ retention (14 days).

cases.question: What are the Raft randomized election timeout bounds, heartbeat interval, and WAL group commit coalescing window?
cases.rationale: Tests multi-section retrieval across Raft leader election timers and Write-Ahead Log group commit settings.

cases.question: Why does GroundCheck avoid relative min-max score normalization per query and how are numeric claims audited?
cases.rationale: Tests retrieval of GroundCheck's own hybrid RRF formula (k_rrf = 20) and 65% numeric fidelity penalty.

cases.question: Under what failure rate and request volume does the webhook circuit breaker trip to OPEN, and what happens when a duplicate X-Bridge-Delivery-Id arrives in-flight?
cases.rationale: Requires combining evidence from Section 3 (idempotency HTTP 409 Conflict) and Section 4 (circuit breaker 50% failure rate across 20 requests).

cases.question: What is the configured emergency pump shutdown timeout for the QuadTank-FDI controller?
cases.rationale: Tests cross-document contradiction detection: QuadTank-FDI Section 4 specifies 45 ms (v2.1 Legacy Manual), whereas Webhook Reliability Section 4 Errata specifies 120 ms for Modbus-TCP gateways.

cases.question: What are theLoRaWAN frequency channel plans and BGP autonomous system peering policies for the satellite telemetry uplink?
cases.rationale: Tests epistemic humility: neither LoRaWAN frequency plans nor BGP satellite peering appear anywhere in the technical corpus. The system must abstain.

cases.question: How many GPU tensor cores and FP8 quantization calibration steps are required to train the Vision Transformer backbone?
cases.rationale: Tests out-of-domain AI terminology trap: although the corpus discusses RAG evaluation, it contains zero information about Vision Transformer GPU training or FP8 quantization.
